final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC and formatted them as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. I normalized service names to lower-case with underscores instead of dashes. I extracted the message after the service name on the first line, and the last line of any traceback as the exception (or null if none). I calculated repeat_count by adding 1 plus any repeats indicated by subsequent "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. I sorted the errors by service and timestamp ascending. I aggregated counts by service summing repeat_count. Finally, I wrote the output JSON file workspace/errors.json with the required structure and metadata keys.

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.
